cases.purpose: Ensure batch grouping and low-water routes expose trade-offs against thermal energy, delivery slack, and wastewater rather than selecting a universal winner.

facts.notes: Illustrative values only; not a production recipe or measured process.

required_invariants: Show named water, energy and schedule objectives separately.
Retain both routes when neither dominates and both satisfy hard constraints.
Reject any route that exceeds the frozen delivery or quality constraint.
forbidden_claims: Do not call either route universally greener or cheaper.
Do not treat synthetic resource values as measured savings.

cases.purpose: Ensure gross throughput and nominal speed do not hide defects, rework, false negatives or reduced accepted output.
required_invariants: Calculate accepted output separately from gross output.
Mark defect performance as incomplete while the false-negative evidence is unknown.
Do not rank a faster process above another using gross output alone.
forbidden_claims: Do not claim general defect-detection accuracy from the synthetic fixture.
Do not treat unobserved defects as absent.

cases.purpose: Prevent a recovered blended fiber from being treated as qualified fiber-to-fiber feedstock when composition or secondary grade is unresolved.
required_invariants: Preserve the conflict between blend claims.
Allow only claims supported by the known collection/sorting state.
Block admission as specification-grade secondary fiber until required grade evidence exists.
forbidden_claims: Do not equate collection, sorting or shredding with fiber-to-fiber recycling.
Do not infer composition or purity from a nominal product name.

cases.purpose: Prevent per-kilogram comparisons from treating products with different verified useful lives as functionally equivalent.

facts.value: one accepted service cycle under profile v1

required_invariants: Keep service-life evidence separate from material intensity.
Do not assert lifecycle superiority while Candidate B service-life evidence is unknown.
Report the missing evidence needed to compare equivalent delivered service.
forbidden_claims: Do not label the lower-mass candidate better per use without service-life support.
Do not convert an unverified durability claim into a measured fact.

cases.purpose: Test schedule robustness when a bottleneck machine becomes unavailable without violating product or delivery constraints silently.
required_invariants: Recompute the schedule under the declared outage scenario.
Use the alternative machine only for routes it is qualified to perform.
Expose infeasibility when the commitment cannot be met.
forbidden_claims: Do not assume the failed machine or unqualified substitute is available.
Do not hide missed delivery behind aggregate throughput.

cases.purpose: Ensure apparent resource gains cannot compensate for missing required wastewater-treatment or discharge evidence.
required_invariants: Block feasibility while the required effluent authority is unknown.
Keep measured/synthetic resource values visible without upgrading admissibility.
Identify the exact missing evidence reference.
forbidden_claims: Do not declare the route feasible because its energy and water figures are favorable.
Do not imply regulatory compliance from this synthetic case.

cases.purpose: Distinguish local assembly from a fully renewable manufacturing chain when critical textile inputs or processes remain imported/unqualified.
required_invariants: Represent local cut/sew capability separately from specialty-input closure.
Preserve the imported dependency and its evidence state.
Do not claim full multi-generation supply closure.
forbidden_claims: Do not equate local assembly with full local industrial capability.
Do not silently substitute an unqualified material.

cases.purpose: Ensure lots sharing a nominal fiber or fabric name remain distinct when source, process version, assay scope or validity conflicts.
required_invariants: Retain distinct lot identities and conflicting claims.
Require compatible scope and validity before evidence can be reused.
Preserve an audit trail for any resolved claim.
forbidden_claims: Do not merge the lots into one evidence subject solely because labels match.
Do not let custody attestations prove product performance.

cases.purpose: Ensure ordering independent jobs, resources and evidence records does not change the canonical result.
required_invariants: Produce the same canonical output for semantically identical inputs.
Record manifest, solver version and seed in the result.
Reject duplicate canonical IDs rather than resolving them by input order.
forbidden_claims: Do not claim determinism across different solver builds or hardware unless tested.
Do not claim that this contract fixture is itself a completed runtime test.

cases.purpose: Prevent a missing material, electricity, waste or transport factor from making a candidate appear artificially favorable.
required_invariants: Mark impact assessment incomplete where required factors are unknown.
Return the highest-impact missing factor or evidence gap as a measurement request.
Do not substitute zero for unknown.
forbidden_claims: Do not declare a lower greenhouse-gas result with incomplete required scope.
Do not present an illustrative emission factor as universal.
